summary: Third Coast Bancshares filed an 8-K announcing the closed sale of substantially all assets of its subsidiary Third Coast Commercial Capital to Gulf Coast Bank & Trust, effective June 25, 2026. Total consideration was ~$27.5 million at closing with a $3.5 million gain and a structured ongoing revenue share. The transaction was a balance sheet optimization step; no board recommendation or advisor was named. The deal involved a subsidiary asset sale, not a parent-level change. Watch for Q2 2026 financial impact and any additional balance sheet repositioning moves.
